mnemonic.meaning: 映 has 日 (sun): the sun lights it up. It shines and stands out.
mnemonic.reading: HIGH, AIR, RUE (はえる): your red scarf stands out high in the air.

examples.ja: 夕日に海が映えている。
examples.en: The sea is glowing in the evening sun.

items.note: Slang 映え (ばえ) = looks good on social media: インスタ映え.

mnemonic.meaning: Rough (粗) at the end (末). Crude, shabby.
mnemonic.reading: SO MATS (そまつ): so many shabby mats.

examples.ja: 食べ物を粗末にしてはいけない。
examples.en: You mustn't waste food.

items.note: 粗末にする = treat carelessly, waste. Polite set phrase: お粗末様でした (after serving food).

mnemonic.meaning: Support (支) with supplies (給). Payment, provision.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, CUE (しきゅう): on cue, she gets her salary paid. Same sound as 至急 (urgent).

examples.ja: 社員に制服が支給される。
examples.en: Employees are provided with uniforms.

items.note: Formal: wages, allowances, equipment.

mnemonic.meaning: 眺 has 目 (eye): what your eyes gaze at. The view.
mnemonic.reading: NAG, A MAY (ながめ): May nags you to come see the view.

examples.ja: この部屋は眺めがいい。
examples.en: This room has a nice view.

items.note: 景色 is very close. 眺めのいい = with a good view.

mnemonic.meaning: The official (官) container (器) in your body. An organ.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, CAN (きかん): the heart is the key organ. Same sound as 期間 (period).

examples.ja: 心臓は大切な器官だ。
examples.en: The heart is an important organ.

items.note: Biology. 臓器 (ぞうき) = internal organs.

mnemonic.meaning: An iron (鉄) road (道). A railway.
mnemonic.reading: TETSU, DOUGH (てつどう): Tetsu sells dough by the railway.

examples.ja: この町には鉄道が通っていない。
examples.en: No railway runs through this town.

items.note: 鉄道ファン / 鉄ちゃん = train enthusiast.

mnemonic.meaning: 前 is before: holding it before. In advance.
mnemonic.reading: MY, MOTTE (まえもって): "My motto: plan in advance."

examples.ja: 前もって連絡してください。
examples.en: Please let us know in advance.

items.note: Same as あらかじめ (more formal) and 事前に.

mnemonic.meaning: 脂 has 月 (flesh): the grease in meat. Fat.
mnemonic.reading: AH, BOO, RA (あぶら): "Ah, boo, Ra!" The sun god hates grease.

examples.ja: この肉は脂が多い。
examples.en: This meat is fatty.

items.note: 脂 = animal fat, grease. 油 = liquid oil. 脂肪 (Level 20) = body fat.

mnemonic.meaning: Meet (会) and measure (計) the money. Accounting, the bill.
mnemonic.reading: KITE, CAKE (かいけい): the bill for the kite and the cake.

examples.ja: すみません、お会計をお願いします。
examples.en: Excuse me, could we have the bill?

items.note: お会計 = paying the bill at a restaurant. Also accounting as a job.

mnemonic.meaning: The source (源) of capital (資). Resources.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, GEN (しげん): she and Gen share their resources.

examples.ja: 日本は天然資源が少ない。
examples.en: Japan has few natural resources.

items.note: 天然資源 = natural resources. 人的資源 = human resources.

mnemonic.meaning: Heat (熱) in the middle (中) of you. Absorbed, enthusiasm.
mnemonic.reading: NET, CHEW (ねっちゅう): you're so absorbed in the internet you forget to chew.

examples.ja: 子供たちはゲームに熱中している。
examples.en: The children are absorbed in their game.

items.note: 〜に熱中する = be crazy about. 熱中症 = heatstroke.

mnemonic.meaning: Things (物) you make (作) grow. Crops.
mnemonic.reading: SACK, MOATS (さくもつ): sacks of crops by the moat.

examples.ja: 今年は作物がよく育った。
examples.en: The crops grew well this year.

items.note: Farm crops. Read さくぶつ, it means a literary work.

mnemonic.meaning: Goods (品) in your hand (手). A magic trick.
mnemonic.reading: TEH, GEE, NA (てじな): "Teh, gee, nah, how did he do that magic trick?"

examples.ja: 彼は手品が上手だ。
examples.en: He's good at magic tricks.

items.note: 手品師 = magician. マジック is also common.

mnemonic.meaning: A surplus (余) part (分). Extra.
mnemonic.reading: YO, BUN (よぶん): "Yo, there's an extra bun."

examples.ja: 余分なお金は持っていない。
examples.en: I don't have any spare money.

items.note: Often "unnecessary": 余分な説明.

mnemonic.meaning: 露 has 雨 (rain) on top: water drops in the morning. Dew.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, YOU (つゆ): the dew wets you. Same sound as 梅雨 (rainy season).

examples.ja: 朝、草に露が光っていた。
examples.en: Dew was glistening on the grass in the morning.

items.note: 露 also appears in 露出 (exposure). 露知らず = not knowing at all.

mnemonic.meaning: The ceremony (儀) of how you go (行). Manners, behaviour.
mnemonic.reading: GYO, GEE (ぎょうぎ): "Gyoza, gee, eat with good manners!"

examples.ja: 子供の行儀が悪い。
examples.en: The child has bad manners.

items.note: 行儀がいい / 悪い = well / badly behaved. Everyday, especially for children.

mnemonic.meaning: 試 is try: a trial, a test.
mnemonic.reading: TAME, SHE (ためし): she tries to tame the horse. A trial.

examples.ja: 試しに一つ食べてみた。
examples.en: I tried one just to see.

items.note: 試しに = as a trial. 試したことがない = never tried.

mnemonic.meaning: 蚊 has 虫 (insect) on the left: a buzzing insect. A mosquito.
mnemonic.reading: KA (か): the mosquito's whine: "kaaa".

examples.ja: 蚊に刺された。
examples.en: I got bitten by a mosquito.

items.note: 蚊に刺される = to get a mosquito bite (刺す, sting).

mnemonic.meaning: Group (組) that fits (合) together. A union.
mnemonic.reading: COO, ME, EYE (くみあい): the pigeon union keeps an eye on me.

examples.ja: 労働組合に入った。
examples.en: I joined the labour union.

items.note: 労働組合 = trade union.

mnemonic.meaning: 個 is individual, and 々 repeats it: each one. Individual.
mnemonic.reading: COCO (ここ): each coconut is individual. Same sound as ここ (here).

examples.ja: 個々の問題について話し合う。
examples.en: We'll discuss each problem individually.

items.note: Formal. 一つ一つ / それぞれ are everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 姓 is 女 (woman) + 生 (birth): the name you're born with. Your surname.
mnemonic.reading: SAY (せい): say your family name.

examples.ja: 結婚して姓が変わった。
examples.en: My surname changed when I got married.

items.note: Formal; on forms. 名字 (みょうじ) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Things (物) to eat (食). Food.
mnemonic.reading: SHOCK, MOATS (しょくもつ): you're shocked to find food in the moat.

examples.ja: 食物アレルギーがある。
examples.en: I have a food allergy.

items.note: Formal; 食べ物 is everyday. 食物連鎖 = food chain.

mnemonic.meaning: A big (大) war (戦). A world war.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, SEN (たいせん): ties in a great war.

examples.ja: 第二次世界大戦は1945年に終わった。
examples.en: The Second World War ended in 1945.

items.note: Mostly 世界大戦 (world war).

mnemonic.meaning: 蒸 has 灬 (fire) at the bottom: steam rises from heat. To steam.
mnemonic.reading: MOO, SUE (むす): Sue steams the cow's milk. It's so humid.

examples.ja: 今日は蒸し暑い。
examples.en: It's hot and humid today.

items.note: 蒸し暑い = muggy. 蒸しパン = steamed bun.

mnemonic.meaning: A thought (思い) attaches (付く) to you. To think of an idea.
mnemonic.reading: OH, MOI, TSU, COO (おもいつく): "Oh, moi!" the pigeon hits upon an idea.

examples.ja: いいアイデアを思い付いた。
examples.en: I thought of a good idea.

items.note: Usually 思いつく. 思いつき = a passing idea.

mnemonic.meaning: Pass (通) to study (学). Commuting to school.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, GACK (つうがく): your daily commute to school, and GACK, a long train ride.

examples.ja: 毎日電車で通学している。
examples.en: I commute to school by train every day.

items.note: 通勤 = commuting to work.

mnemonic.meaning: Not (不) possible (可). Not allowed, a fail.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, CAR (ふか): the foo dog is not allowed in the car.

examples.ja: ペットの持ち込みは不可です。
examples.en: Pets are not allowed.

items.note: On signs and forms. 不可能 = impossible. As a grade: F.

mnemonic.meaning: 貸 is lend: what you lent. A loan, a favour you're owed.
mnemonic.reading: CASH, EE (かし): you lent him cash, eee!

examples.ja: 彼には一つ貸しがある。
examples.en: He owes me one.

items.note: Opposite of 借り (Level 15). 貸し出し = lending out (library).

mnemonic.meaning: 刈 has 刂 (knife): cut with a blade. To mow, to cut grass.
mnemonic.reading: CAR, RUE (かる): you mow the grass around the car.

examples.ja: 庭の草を刈った。
examples.en: I mowed the grass in the garden.

items.note: Godan: 刈った. For grass, hair, crops. 髪を刈る = cut hair short.

mnemonic.meaning: BAT, TARRY (ばったり): you unexpectedly bump into a bat that tarries.

examples.ja: 駅で先生にばったり会った。
examples.en: I ran into my teacher at the station.

items.note: Usually ばったり会う (run into someone). Also falling with a thud.
